cases.name: compileall
cases.evidence: python -m compileall -q src tests

cases.name: fresh database
cases.evidence: Temporary Store databases used by event, API, CLI, thread and process tests

cases.name: schema constraints
cases.evidence: Existing tests cover animal uniqueness, foreign keys, behavior checks and idempotency uniqueness; animal_events has no SQL CHECK constraint for hash shape or event type

cases.name: event genesis
cases.evidence: ANIMAL_CREATED event starts from 64 zero-byte genesis hash and verifies

cases.name: event append
cases.evidence: Store and API append tests plus event-chain concurrency tests

cases.name: chain verification
cases.evidence: Existing event contract tests and all concurrency runs verify the entire chain

cases.name: tamper detection
cases.evidence: Changes to hashed fields, interior deletion and reordering fail verification; deleting only the tail or all events cannot be detected without an external checkpoint

cases.name: deterministic hash
cases.evidence: Frozen UTF-8 canonical byte vector and SHA-256 digest test

cases.name: thread concurrency
cases.evidence: 8 Store instances, 8 threads, 320 successful appends; chain valid and integrity_check=ok

cases.name: multi-process 2 writers
cases.evidence: 2 spawned processes × 40 appends; 80/80 successful; no chain fork

cases.name: multi-process 4 writers
cases.evidence: 4 spawned processes × 40 appends; 160/160 successful; no chain fork

cases.name: multi-process 8 writers
cases.evidence: 8 spawned processes × 40 appends; 320/320 successful; no chain fork

cases.name: high-contention race
cases.evidence: Deterministic pre-fix two-process head-read barrier reproduction documented; fixed implementation then passed simultaneous 2/4/8-process Store append tests

cases.name: duplicate/idempotency
cases.evidence: Behavior observations are idempotent by (animal_id,idempotency_key), returning same record on exact retry and 409 on conflicting retry; event API has no idempotency key and a retried append is another event

cases.name: transaction rollback
cases.evidence: Injected event insert failure rolls back owned append transaction; injected positions failure rolls back preceding telemetry rows in save_episode

cases.name: crash recovery
cases.evidence: Writer was terminated during repeated append load; reopened DB passed SQLite and chain checks and accepted another append. No power-loss or filesystem fault was simulated

cases.name: kill test
cases.evidence: Independent spawned writer process terminated while appending; database reopened and validated

cases.name: SQLite integrity_check
cases.evidence: PRAGMA integrity_check returned ok after all thread/process stress and kill recovery runs

cases.name: restart
cases.evidence: Store close/reopen and continued event writes tested in event contract, legacy migration, observation and killed-writer flows

cases.name: migration
cases.evidence: Legacy schema without schema_version is opened, additively migrated, reopened, and appended without rehashing old rows; migration interruption was not injected

cases.name: API write path
cases.evidence: Animal and event API validation/write/verify plus behavior idempotency/retry tests pass; event API does not deduplicate retries and DB busy exhaustion is not separately injected

cases.name: CLI write path
cases.evidence: cattle-rf demo run with one animal/anchor wrote telemetry, positions, metrics and animal event through Store; database reopened and verified

cases.name: observation persistence
cases.evidence: Behavior observation round-trip, model/source/evidence provenance, idempotent retry and reopen tests

cases.name: prediction persistence
cases.evidence: Prediction rows are persisted through BehaviorObservation with observation_kind=PREDICTION, model_version, source and evidence_status; no separate prediction database/store was found

cases.name: failure injection
cases.evidence: Invalid input, foreign key/unique constraint, injected insert triggers and temporary SQLite writer lock release tested; timeout exhaustion and disk/path failure not injected

cases.name: stress
cases.evidence: 880 appends across 2/4/8-process and 8-thread scenarios succeeded; no lost event rows, chain forks or SQLite integrity errors; local test elapsed time is not generalizable

cases.evidence: 630 passed, 7 skipped, 1 warning in 50.67s from a clean detached checkout

cases.evidence: Working-tree and staged report diff checks passed after artifact generation

deployment_gate.scope: Independent local processes using canonical Store/API event append paths, one local SQLite file, tested at 2, 4 and 8 writer processes and 40 appends per writer
not_proven: callers that pass an already-open deferred transaction directly to append_event
deployment_gate.supported_mode: Multiple local processes may write through Store/API using SQLite WAL on a local filesystem; SQLite serializes each event append with BEGIN IMMEDIATE and waits up to 5 seconds for the writer lock. No application retry is provided after timeout.
